title: Replaying the chant recording raises the temperature and brings an orb

tellings.quote: Temperature elevated and in that exercise an orb of light appeared in the homestead

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, replaying a recording of a chant inside a building called Homestead 2 reportedly made the temperature rise and brought a ball of light into the room. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells it first-hand as something that happened during an exercise there in the 2020s.
